text: 英国经济5月意外实现了增长，这表明面对政治动荡和能源价格上涨，消费者和企业的韧性比预期的更强。 英国国家统计局周四表示，5月份国内生产总值上升了0.1%，4月份曾下降0.1%。经济学家此前预计该数据将持平。受医疗科学研发领域以及零售业表现强劲的推动，5月服务业环比增长0.3%，温暖的天气促使消费者前往商店购物。与此同时，建筑业下降0.8%，工业生产下降0.5%，原因是制造业的小幅增长被能源和公用事业产出的下降所抵消。在经济夹在政治风波和能源危机之间的背景下，整体经济出现了温和改善。
text_en: The UK economy unexpectedly grew in May, showing that consumers and businesses were more resilient than expected amid political turmoil and energy price rises. The Office for National Statistics said on Thursday that GDP rose 0.1% in May, after a 0.1% decline in April. Economists had expected the data to be flat. The services sector grew 0.3% month-on-month in May, driven by strong performance in medical science R&D and retail, with warm weather prompting consumers to visit shops. Meanwhile, construction fell 0.8%, and industrial production fell 0.5%, as a small increase in manufacturing was offset by a decline in energy and utility output. The overall economy showed a moderate improvement amid political shocks and an energy crisis.
